findings: International Relations previous limited classification differs from conditional recommendation: current title guidance links Sage policy, with no separate ban found; partial drafting remains an inference and prompt-generated submission boundary is undefined.
Acta Sociologica current page timed out; June 2025 Sage PDF is accessible but historical, so retain unclear rather than assert a current title-specific clearance.
Journal of Management Education references AI guidance via a wrapped safelinks URL; publisher applicability is supported but direct target was not independently verified.
Both Science, Technology, & Human Values memberships receive identical AI classifications and restrictions.
Prior shorthand statements that Sage expressly permits generated drafting overstate policy; combined-clause inference and uncertainty are preserved for every recommendation.
